sources.excerpt: Phattie Overdrive Previous Her Majesty Drive/Fuzz Next Blood Drive Overdrive Phattie Overdrive Phattie Overdrive Sale Price: $149.00 Original Price: $159.00 Phattie: A high gain overdrive pedal, the Phattie gives you dynamic British amp-like response and a powerful three band EQ section. Byron first designed this back in 2003 to emulate the glorious tones of his favorite JTM45. Capable of light drive to quite heavy grind, it cleans up very, very well from your guitar's volume control. There's plenty of gain on tap to satisfy most rock styles, and it's equally at home as a primary rhythm sound, boosting an already dirty amp, or stacking with other dirt pedals. It's basically like having the sweet tones of a boutique British-style amp in a handy package you can take with you anywhere! The Gain control has a wide range, from on-the-edge breakup, to classic rock crunch, to all the heaviness a rock player could ever ask for. The effective three band EQ makes it incredibly versatile. It's capable of a deep 6l6 mid scoop, or a rich El34 mid boost, and total control over the lows and highs. If you find the typical overdrive pedal to be lacking in bass, too compressed, and without enough drive and tone control on tap, the Phattie is for you. Handmade for you in Columbia, MO! sold out Get notified by email when this product is in stock. Sign up to receive news and updates.
